recipe_note: uk-saas is a jurisdictional mismatch for this AU private-sector project. Excluded on this run: TCOP, SBD, DPIA, SVCASS, GOV_REUSE. ADR topics were retargeted from UK-specific framings (G-Cloud, GOV.UK One Login) to Australian equivalents (institutional procurement, APP 8). Consider authoring .arckit/recipes/au-private.yaml before further builds.

ADR-002.topic: Authoritative source for institutional role assignment

ADR-OBSERVABILITY.topic: Logging and observability stack for integrations
ADR-OBSERVABILITY.agent_summary: Chose layered observability plane (endpoint health / OpenTelemetry flow telemetry / entity-state reconciliation), vendor-neutral instrumentation, backend deferred to Principle 19 test. Layer 3 sequenced first as it works against today's estate pre-broker.

ADR-OSSLICENCE.topic: Open-source licence and third-party component policy
ADR-OSSLICENCE.agent_summary: Chose Register-and-Assess: extend capability map + RIFF checklist with licence_identifier, patch_and_support_owner, deployment_mode. Assessment depth set by deployment mode, not licence type. Estate has only two OSS components (H5P, MuseScore); copyleft obligations dormant, real exposure is operational.

ADR-TOPOLOGY.agent_summary: Chose single Australian region multi-AZ with cross-region recovery from code. Three tiers (prod/non-prod/sandpit) separated by subscription + identity boundary; PI prohibited outside production. Discharges ADR-001 Condition 2.

ADR-CLOUD.topic: Cloud platform selection for university-controlled workloads
ADR-CLOUD.agent_summary: Complements ADR-005 (which set region topology but deferred provider). Scoped to UoF-controlled integration plane, not vendor SaaS re-platforming. Agent was killed during final reporting; file written and validated by line count.

STRATEGY.agent_summary: Five themes partitioning SOBC one-off lines. Top: Governed Integration on a Canonical Model (AUD 1.25-2.25M, 56%); Declared Capability Boundaries (400-730k, 18%); Consistent Accessible Student Experience (300-550k, 14%). Flagged SOBC internal inconsistency in one-off:recurring ratio. Landed in project 001, not 000-global.

PLAN.agent_summary: Two-stage: Stage A engagement WP1-WP9 to 31 Aug 2026; Stage B indicative delivery programme Q4 2026-2028+, explicitly unfunded. RIFF gates G0-G6. Critical path 21-31 Aug has no float. Surfaced unlogged gap: SA departs 31 Aug with no scheduled knowledge transfer.

FINOPS.agent_summary: Reframed from cloud consumption to SaaS licence management. Levers: retire declared duplication (Teams/Zoom/Echo360); realise licensed-but-unconfigured capability; prevent net-new acquisition. Six of seven levers blocked behind the 2026-08-21 licence baseline. No dollar figures invented; 111 TBD-WP3 markers all closed out in section 17.

ORG_RESEARCH.topic: Target organisation strategy, structure, existing systems
ORG_RESEARCH.agent_summary: Agent killed during final reporting; file written. Recipe targeted 000-global/research/ but hook allocated projects/001-lt-ecosystem/research/. Needs review to confirm the fictional-organisation constraint was honoured (no fabricated enrolment/revenue facts).

ADR-IDENTITY.agent_summary: IdP as single enforcement plane: SAML/OIDC federation, MFA once at IdP, LTI 1.3 launch context, SCIM 2.0 event-driven deactivate consuming ADR-002 E-006. Three-outcome disposition for the two local-account platforms. Named admin accounts + vaulted break-glass. 6 conditions. Notes MFA maturity NOT raised, only its exception removed.

ADR-RESIDENCY.agent_summary: Governed accountable offshore disclosure. Four-tier class rule: Tier 0 absolute prohibition for sensitive info (class 5 placement); Tier 1 full-assessment (class 3 work, class 6 exam/proctoring); Tier 2 minimised (class 7, class 4); Tier 3 AU-and-to-remain. Six-question APP 8 assessment, standard cross-border schedule incl. certified destruction. Found REQ gap: NFR-I-002/DR-007 cover retrieval but not recipient destruction (Condition 4).
ADR-RESIDENCY.topic: Data residency and cross-border disclosure under APP 8

ADR-AI.agent_summary: Advisory-only inference under human-determinative process + governed AI/ML service register. No AI output determinative; no threshold gate on marking; cohort-disaggregated equity monitoring with suspension trigger; no training on student work. ERROR TO FIX: agent asserted 'no RISK register exists' and held RISK-A1-A12 in-document, but ARC-001-RISK-v1.0 has 28 R-xxx entries. Migrate those risks.
ADR-AI.topic: AI and ML services in the learning ecosystem

ADR-BUILDBUY.agent_summary: Staged sourcing hierarchy: Realise -> Extend -> Aggregate (consortium) -> Buy -> Build, binding on RIFF gate and renewals. Exhaust licensed capability first. References ADR-001 Condition 1 as worked Gate 1 example. Warning: 3-option cap meant no standalone build option; may want 4-option revision.
ADR-BUILDBUY.topic: Build versus buy and procurement approach

GLOSSARY.agent_summary: PLUGIN BUG: hook rejected ARC-001-GLOS-v1.0.md — 'GLOS' absent from config/doc-types.mjs though commands/glossary.md:105 specifies it. Written as GLOSSARY.md with canonical ID in Document Control. NOT discoverable by ArcKit tooling (ARC-* prefix). ~93 terms, 34 acronyms.

WARDLEY.agent_summary: Distinct from WARD-001 (whole-estate, 3 anchors): maps the PeopleSoft-to-platforms data path. Findings: chain is inverted (9 flows avg evolution 0.264 vs substrate 0.662); broker is NOT where risk is (none of 13 edges above R=0.5 pass through it) — Declared Role Authority and Conflict Resolution Rule are decisions, belong in Phase 0; conflict C-1 splits into substrate vs endpoint-count decisions; INT-007 under-prioritised (MEDIUM but R=0.722).
